title: Regularity descends along flat maps surjective on spectra
statement: Let $A\to B\to C$ be ring maps of commutative rings. If the composite $A\to C$ is a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], and $B\to C$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and induces a surjective map $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ (every prime ideal of $B$ is the inverse image of a prime ideal of $C$), then $A\to B$ is a regular ring map.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NT (lemma-regular-permanence, line 10507); its proof uses Algebra Lemma 039V (lemma-flat-permanence) and Algebra Lemma 07NH (lemma-geometrically-regular-descent)

proof.text: Because $B\to C$ is flat and surjective on spectra, it is faithfully flat by the public descent criterion [lem-weil-pbc-flat-surjective-spectrum-faithfully-flat]. Since the composite $A\to C$ is regular, $C$ is flat as an $A$-module by [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. Apply the flat-permanence lemma [lem-weil-pbc-flat-permanence] with $R=A$, $S=B$, and the $B$-module $M=C$: $M$ is flat over $A$ and faithfully flat over $B$, so $A\to B$ is flat.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07NT, first sentence; Algebra Lemma Tag 039V

proof.text: Fix a prime $\mathfrak p\subset A$. Base changing the flat map $B\to C$ along $A\to\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ gives a flat map $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to C\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ by flat base change [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-base-change]. The original map on spectra is surjective, so its base change is surjective by [lem-weil-pbc-spec-surjective-base-change]. It is therefore faithfully flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-surjective-spectrum-faithfully-flat]. The target fibre $C\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is geometrically regular over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ because $A\to C$ is regular [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. Geometric regularity descends through this faithfully flat map by [lem-weil-pbc-geometrically-regular-descent], so the fibre $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is geometrically regular.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07NT, second and third sentences; Algebra Lemma Tags 00HI and 07NH

proof.text: The fibre $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is Noetherian as required in the definition of a regular ring map: geometric regularity in [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] includes Noetherianity after every finite purely inseparable field extension, and the descent lemma [lem-weil-pbc-geometrically-regular-descent] preserves this regular-ring condition. Thus $A\to B$ is flat with Noetherian geometrically regular fibres, exactly the definition of a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].

split_report.summary: Split Stacks More on Algebra Lemma 07NT into flatness descent (039V) and fibrewise geometric-regularity descent (07NH), with public nodes for the reusable faithfully-flat criterion (00HQ) and surjective-spectrum base change (00FI). The proof follows the source: B to C flat and spectrum-surjective is faithfully flat; apply 039V to the composite A to C; for each prime of A, flat base change and 00FI give a faithfully flat map of fibres, then 07NH descends geometric regularity and Noetherianity.
